list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, target_id AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY target_id

list.name: advisor_group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: priority
list.query: SELECT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(priority, 'UNKNOWN') AS priority FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot) s ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, priority

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id)
      g.target_id,
      g.run_id,
      g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id

    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})

panels.title: Top databases to fix in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id)
      g.target_id,
      g.run_id,
      g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY g.target_id, g.collected_at DESC
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    ON ls.target_id = g.target_id
   AND ls.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  target_id,
  count(*) AS findings,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') AS high_priority,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high_risk,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY') AS manual_only,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_lock IS TRUE) AS requires_lock,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) AS maintenance_window,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE risk_level IN ('LOW','MEDIUM')
      AND requires_lock IS FALSE
      AND requires_maintenance_window IS FALSE
      AND can_generate_sql IS TRUE
  ) AS quick_wins,
  round(avg(confidence)::numeric, 1) AS avg_confidence,
  round(avg(impact)::numeric, 1) AS avg_impact,
  max(rank_position) AS max_rank,
  max(collected_at) AS last_collected_at,
  (
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') * 100 +
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') * 80 +
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY') * 50 +
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_lock IS TRUE) * 40 +
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) * 30 +
    coalesce(max(rank_position), 0)
  ) AS db_attention_score
FROM current_findings
GROUP BY target_id
ORDER BY db_attention_score DESC, high_priority DESC, high_risk DESC, findings DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Latest prioritized findings in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id)
      g.target_id,
      g.run_id,
      g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY g.target_id, g.collected_at DESC
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    ON ls.target_id = g.target_id
   AND ls.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  g.target_id, g.rank_position, g.priority, g.risk_level, g.advisor_group, g.category_id,
  g.action_type, g.action_safety, g.requires_lock, g.requires_maintenance_window,
  g.object_type, g.schema_name, g.table_name, g.column_name, g.index_name,
  g.title, g.recommendation_note, g.improvement_sql
FROM current_findings g
ORDER BY
  CASE g.priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  CASE g.risk_level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
  g.rank_position DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

   OR manual_review_required IS TRUE

SELECT
  date_trunc('${bucket:raw}', g.collected_at) AS time,
  coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') AS metric,
  count(*) AS findings
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Critical findings by database over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('${bucket:raw}', g.collected_at) AS time,
  g.target_id AS metric,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.priority = 'HIGH' OR g.risk_level = 'HIGH') AS critical_findings
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Recurring findings in selected time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  target_id,
  finding_fingerprint,
  min(collected_at) AS first_seen,
  max(collected_at) AS last_seen,
  count(DISTINCT run_id) AS occurrences,
  max(priority) AS priority,
  max(risk_level) AS risk_level,
  max(advisor_group) AS advisor_group,
  max(category_id) AS category_id,
  max(object_type) AS object_type,
  max(object_name) AS object_name,
  max(title) AS title,
  max(recommendation_note) AS recommendation_note
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(priority, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${priority:sqlstring})
GROUP BY target_id, finding_fingerprint
ORDER BY occurrences DESC, max(rank_position) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
